t:WARRIOR:Booming Voice.old: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.
t:WARRIOR:Booming Voice.new: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.

t:WARRIOR:Unbridled Wrath.old: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.
t:WARRIOR:Unbridled Wrath.new: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

t:WARRIOR:Dual Wield Specialization.old: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25%, off-hand Rage generation by 100%, and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.
t:WARRIOR:Dual Wield Specialization.new: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.
t:WARRIOR:Dual Wield Specialization.note: In between, build 70170 had no off-hand Rage bonus and kept the 10% off-hand hit.

t:WARRIOR:Bloodthirst.old: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Bloodthirst.new: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.old: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.new: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 6.0 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Raging Blows.old: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your off-hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.
t:WARRIOR:Raging Blows.new: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.

t:WARRIOR:Furious Precision.new: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

t:WARRIOR:Lingering Rage.new: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Gore Drinker.new: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 6 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

t:WARRIOR:Improved Cleave.old: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 3.

t:WARRIOR:Precision.old: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

t:WARRIOR:Toughness.old: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

t:WARRIOR:Iron Will.old: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.
t:WARRIOR:Iron Will.new: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.
t:WARRIOR:Iron Will.note: Moved from Fury to Protection, row 1.

t:PALADIN:Redoubt.old: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 30%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.
t:PALADIN:Redoubt.new: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 20%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

t:PALADIN:Holy Shield.old: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.
t:PALADIN:Holy Shield.new: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

t:PALADIN:Champion of the Light.old: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 100% of your Intellect.
t:PALADIN:Champion of the Light.new: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect.

t:PALADIN:Reckoning.old: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.
t:PALADIN:Reckoning.new: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike. Cannot occur more often than once every 1.5 sec.

t:HUNTER:Sniper Shot.old: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.
t:HUNTER:Sniper Shot.new: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

t:HUNTER:Expose Prey.old: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.
t:HUNTER:Expose Prey.new: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.

t:ROGUE:Setup.old: Gives you a 100% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging an attack or fully resisting a spell.
t:ROGUE:Setup.new: Gives you a 100% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

t:PRIEST:Penance.old: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 81 Holy damage to an enemy, or 184 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
t:PRIEST:Penance.new: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 42 Holy damage to an enemy, or 126 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

t:PRIEST:Inner Focus.old: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.
t:PRIEST:Inner Focus.new: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

t:SHAMAN:Mana Tide Totem.old: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
t:SHAMAN:Mana Tide Totem.new: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

t:SHAMAN:Water Shield.old: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
t:SHAMAN:Water Shield.new: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's healing spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
t:SHAMAN:Water Shield.note: The client drops a 15 sec cooldown that Blizzard says never applied in play.

t:MAGE:Combustion.old: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.
t:MAGE:Combustion.new: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

t:MAGE:Heating Up.old: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 20 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
t:MAGE:Heating Up.new: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

t:WARLOCK:Soul Harvest.old: You gain Soul Harvest for 10 sec if a victim is killed while afflicted with your Drain Soul. Soul Harvest allows your Mana to regenerate at 100% of normal speed while you are casting spells, and grants a 100% increase to your Mana regeneration.
t:WARLOCK:Soul Harvest.new: Killing a non-trivial target afflicted by your Drain Soul increases your Mana regeneration by 100% for 10 sec and allows 100% of normal Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

t:DRUID:Shifting Power.new: Instantly convert 55% of base Mana into 40 Energy. Cat Form only. 16 sec cooldown.
t:DRUID:Shifting Power.note: Read from the spell's data: the client's tooltip template cannot print its own numbers yet.

t:DRUID:Improved Shifting Power.new: Reduces the cooldown of your Shifting Power spell by 8 sec.

t:DRUID:King of the Jungle.old: Tiger's Fury now instantly grants you 180 Energy.

t:DRUID:Natural Instinct.old: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 40%.
t:DRUID:Natural Instinct.new: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 40% and increases your spell healing by 50% of your Intellect.

Retribution Aura.new: Causes 20 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura.old: Causes 30 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura.note: Rank 5 shown. Blizzard: base damage back to Vanilla, spell power ratio 13.3% to 6%.

Thorns.new: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.
Thorns.old: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 22 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.
Thorns.note: Rank 6 shown. Blizzard: base damage back to Vanilla, spell power ratio 13.3% to 6%.

Berserker Rage.new: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Fireball.new: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 120 Fire damage and an additional 16 Fire damage over 8 sec.
Fireball.old: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 108 Fire damage and an additional 16 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Arcane Missiles.new: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 47 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.
Arcane Missiles.old: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 44 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

Lightning Bolt.new: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 82 Nature damage.
Lightning Bolt.old: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 72 Nature damage.

Shadow Bolt.new: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 58 Shadow damage.
Shadow Bolt.old: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 56 Shadow damage.

Smite.new: Smite an enemy for 60 Holy damage.
Smite.old: Smite an enemy for 59 Holy damage.

Wrath.new: Causes 37 Nature damage to the target.
Wrath.old: Causes 38 Nature damage to the target.

Disease Cleansing Totem.new: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 5 min.
Disease Cleansing Totem.old: Summons a Disease Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease effect from party members within 30 yards every 5 seconds. Lasts 2 min.

Disengage.new: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. Disables auto-attack.
Disengage.note: Threat drop doubled in the data on 1 October (rank 1: 140 to 280); Blizzard's 8 October notes say it now really applies.

Sonic Blast.new: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 84 Nature damage and increasing the casting time of all spells by 60% for 30 sec.
Sonic Blast.note: Added to the Bat pet's abilities, ranks 1 to 5. Rank 5 shown.

Will of the Forsaken.new: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.
Will of the Forsaken.note: Same text. The data now grants a short immunity instead of a dispel, so it works while asleep or charmed.

Furious Howl.new: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 82. Lasts 1 min.
Furious Howl.old: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 136. Lasts 1 min.
Furious Howl.note: Wolf pet ability, rank 4 shown. Not in Blizzard's notes.

8345.name: Wolfshead Helm
effects: Equip: You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 5 Energy from activating Shifting Power.
oldEffects: Equip: You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 20 Energy from activating Shifting Power.
